data.name: 高球王者 GolfKings
data.detailed_description:
Discord：

Telegram：

⛳ This isn’t just golf — it’s a cross-world, time-bending swing adventure!

Ever imagined driving a ball through the poetic brush-stroke scenery of A Panorama of Rivers and Mountains?

Challenging a rooftop green above a neon cyber-city skyline?

Or smashing golf balls to fight zombies and awaken ancient dragons?

GolfKings breaks the traditional limits of golf — built on authentic swing physics and infused with bold, imaginative gameplay.

Step into a golf universe unlike anything you’ve seen before. Get ready to swing through worlds and rewrite the rules of golf. 🏌️‍♂️🔥

🎯 Three Core Modes — A Full-Spectrum Golf Experience

🏌️‍♂️ Competitive · Course Mode

Eastern Art · Panorama Fantasy:
Step into a world inspired by the legendary A Panorama of Rivers and Mountains —
a watercolor fairytale where every swing paints a new scene,
and every hole feels like walking through a living masterpiece.

🎪 Creative · Fun Mode
We break the boundaries of traditional golf — merging golf with unique mechanics, fresh environments, and playful challenges to create a lighthearted yet skill-driven arcade experience:

Precision Landing Challenge:
Experience a modern take on the classic TopGolf style —
precise ball control is king.

● City Clash:
Tee off atop futuristic skyscrapers — chase high-altitude greens among neon lights and electric skylines.

● Cliffside Target Strike:
Stand above the clouds on floating cliffs and hit fixed or moving targets —a mental and mechanical test pushing your accuracy to the limit.

● Bowling Smash Challenge:
Golf meets bowling — line it up, send it flying, and feel the thrill of a perfect strike!

● Blackjack 21 Mode:
When golf strategy meets card-game mindplay — face off against AI in a battle of math, skill, and nerve.

● Victory Island:
Advance endlessly across mystical floating islands — only precise, consistent shots will take you further.

🏋️‍♂️ Immersive · Training Mode
This isn’t just practice — it’s a visual and sensory playground designed to sharpen skill and elevate experience:

● Sakura / Pro Practice Range:
Swing beneath falling cherry blossoms, strike temple gongs, hit glowing rings —
and awaken the mythical Eastern dragon!

● Tomorrowland Defense Range:
A challenge for the brave — fend off zombie waves with pure golf skill and defend humanity’s last hope.

● Ocean Hunter Range:
Face the king of the seas — take aim at a charging shark in a tense, heart-pounding ocean showdown!

✨ Game Highlights — A New Generation of Golf Adventure

● True-to-Life Swing Physics
Powered by realistic physics simulation, GolfKings delivers authentic ball flight, spin, and roll behavior —
every shot demands planning, precision, and adaptability.

● A Boundless Matrix of Creative Modes
From ink-wash Eastern art to neon cyber cities,
from traditional courses to fantasy battles —
this isn’t just golf. It’s golf re-imagined across genres and worlds.

● Fun for Every Style of Player
Chase perfection in competitive precision modes,
or kick back and enjoy lighthearted, imaginative challenges.
Whether you're hardcore or casual, there's always a green waiting for you here.

🏆 Everything is ready — all that’s missing is your first swing!

The world of GolfKings is a fairway where reality meets imagination,
where skill evolves through creativity, and every shot writes a story.

Here, you are not only a golfer —
you are the one who defines what a golf legend can be.

Join us — and swing your way into a world of endless possibilities.

data.short_description: Golf King: True-to-Life Swing, Creative Play! A uniquely new golf game. Course Mode: A whole new challenge every time! Entertainment Mode: Cyberpunk Rooftop Duel, Tee Shot on Misty Cliffs, Bowling-inspired Putting, and a variety of other creative game modes.

Simplified Chinese*, English*, Russian*, Japanese*, Traditional Chinese*, Korean*
*languages with full audio support

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForece 1060 Ti (6G显存)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
